source.title_en: The September Treasury International Capital (TIC) data doesn't change the central story around capital flows there days: the intense gravitation pull of the US equity market.

title: Brad Setser：9 月 TIC 数据的主线没变，全球资金仍被美股牢牢吸住
dek: 他认为外资对美国资产需求依旧强劲，债券流入近期回升；中国在美托管的国债和机构债只有按储备推算应有水平的一半左右，但托管地口径让“撤离美债”难以反驳，也无法排除只是换了托管地。

original.title: September TIC data (thread, 12 posts)
original.text_md:
The September Treasury International Capital (TIC) data doesn't change the central story around capital flows there days: the intense gravitation pull of the US equity market. 

(the TIC data is lagged, DB Sarevelos says foreign investors also bought the dip in November)

1/

**Thread post, https://x.com/Brad_Setser/status/2123192560776831013**

As noted earlier, bond inflows have picked up recently (a  bit to my surprise to be honest, they had been soft for some time) -- So the overall story is still of strong demand for all US assets (tho more so for risk assets)

2/

**Thread post, https://x.com/Brad_Setser/status/2123193261921632526**

This is the era of the "profit dollar" (to use Tooze's phrase) not the era of official flows into safe assets -- it is a privately funded external deficit.

But the dip in China's holdings is sure to get attention (probably too much tbh)

3/

**Thread post, https://x.com/Brad_Setser/status/2123193717821771911**

China's holdings of LT Treasuries and Agencies in US custodians (note the caveat) are about 1/2 what they should be based on SAFE's reserve holdings ($3.4 trillion of fx) and its historical allocation to US bonds

4/

**Thread post, https://x.com/Brad_Setser/status/2123194159813046458**

The recent dip in holdings in the US relative to reserves means that it is difficult to disprove an argument China is shifting away from US bonds at the margin -- 

At the same time, the scale of holdings in custodial centers make it impossible to prove that China isn't just shifting to non-US custodians

5/

**Thread post, https://x.com/Brad_Setser/status/2123194599086727486**

The fall in Agencies held in US custodians has been just as steep incidentally --  with some of recent dip also from valuation changes

6/

**Thread post, https://x.com/Brad_Setser/status/2123194807522844703**

At the same time, there are now plenty of Agencies in Canada and European custodial centers ...

7/

**Thread post, https://x.com/Brad_Setser/status/2123195412748054659**

A technical point --  theTreasuries in Belgian custodians have been up in recent months (even with valuation losses) while the Treasuries in French custodians are down.   At the margin that suggests China may be using Euroclear more than the French custodians right now

8/

**Thread post, https://x.com/Brad_Setser/status/2123195944552284627**

As a result my old methodology of using Belgium as a proxy for all non US custodians doesn't suggest that much of a real shift away from Treasuries

9/

**Thread post, https://x.com/Brad_Setser/status/2123196273138504119**

While my new methodology (taking a fraction of all the Treasuries in EU custodians) suggests more of a shift out of Treasuries

10/

**Thread post, https://x.com/Brad_Setser/status/2123197274343805056**

It doesn't much matter tho -- in q3 all of the fx bought in settlement went to the banks or some investment fund ... the PBOC's balance sheet reserves didn't rise ... and the bank/ investment fund flow never has appeared in US custodians

11/

**Thread post, https://x.com/Brad_Setser/status/2123197726653616339**

And while it doesn't fit neatly into the global balance of payments (which implies a flow from China to the US) the overarching story is still one of strong global demand for US risk ...

12/12

body_md:
美国财政部 9 月的国际资本流动（TIC）数据出来了。Brad Setser 在一条 12 帖的串帖里说，这份数据没有改变这段时间资本流动的主线：**美国股市对全球资金的强大引力**。

他提醒，TIC 数据有滞后。德意志银行的 Sarevelos 说，外国投资者在 11 月也逢低买入了美股。

债券方面，Setser 说外资流入近期有所回升。他坦言这有点出乎他的意料，因为此前很长一段时间债券流入都偏弱。所以整体看，全球对所有美国资产的需求仍然强劲，只是对风险资产更强。

## 私人资金撑起的外部赤字

他借用 Adam Tooze 的说法，称现在是“利润美元”（profit dollar）的时代，并非官方资金流入安全资产的时代：美国的外部赤字靠私人资金来融资。

不过他预计，中国持仓的下降一定会引来关注，而且他直言，关注可能会过多。

## 中国的美债持仓：撤离说难以反驳，换托管说也无法排除

按 Setser 的测算，中国在美国托管机构持有的长期国债和机构债，大约只有应有水平的一半。所谓应有水平，是按国家外汇管理局（SAFE）3.4 万亿美元的外汇储备，以及它历史上配置美国债券的比例推算出来的。他特别提醒，这个数字只统计美国托管机构里的持仓，这是重要前提。

近期中国在美持仓相对储备有所下降，这让人很难反驳“中国在边际上正在远离美债”的说法。可另一方面，各托管中心的持仓规模很大，又让人无法排除另一种解释：中国只是把资产转到了美国以外的托管机构。

他顺带提到，美国托管机构里的机构债下降得同样陡，其中近期的一部分下滑来自估值变化。

与此同时，加拿大和欧洲的托管中心里现在有大量机构债。

## 比利时和法国托管机构走势分化

一个技术细节：最近几个月，比利时托管机构持有的美国国债在增加（即便有估值损失），法国托管机构持有的则在减少。Setser 认为，这在边际上说明中国眼下可能更多地使用 Euroclear，较少使用法国的托管机构。

因此，按他过去的方法，把比利时当作所有非美国托管机构的代理指标，看不出中国真正大幅撤离美国国债。

按他的新方法，取欧盟所有托管机构所持美国国债中的一部分来估算，结果则显示中国撤离美国国债的幅度更大。

## 结汇买来的外汇去了银行和基金

但他说，这其实没那么要紧。三季度结汇买入的外汇全部流向了银行或某些投资基金，人民银行资产负债表上的储备并没有增加；而银行和投资基金的这部分资金流，从来没有出现在美国托管机构的数据里。

他最后写道，这一点放不进全球国际收支的整齐框架（框架意味着资金从中国流向美国），但总的故事仍然是全球对美国风险资产的强劲需求。

读 TIC 里中国持仓的变化时，可以按 Setser 的思路先拆三件事：托管地口径（美国、比利时、法国、欧盟其他托管中心），估值变化，以及结汇外汇是否落在银行和基金手里。只看美国托管机构的数字，既证明不了中国在撤离美债，也排除不了这种可能。
